method.name: html-text-with-manual-source-inspection
method.description: Python HTMLParser extracts title, h1 and paragraph text from the supplied 14-line HTML; audit agent inspected all original lines and meaningful elements.

tool.name: Python standard library html.parser.HTMLParser and terminal source reader

coverage.scope: All title, heading and seven paragraph text elements in the entire 14-line HTML document.
limitations: No source authenticity or historical completeness is established by extraction.
